title: Matched model and policy trajectories
population: Non-held-out training worlds from the fixed pilot pool. Purposively selected cases include agreements and disagreements.

items.title: Pilot arms choose different objects
items.caption: T0 moved while the laptop remained hidden, then selected the book. T4 immediately selected the bowl.
items.input_and_actions: Pilot training update 50, sampled pre-update actor decisions. Original 255x255 public marked observations and original 512x512 model images reconstructed losslessly from the authenticated table, checked against every full prior-image sequence in the training journal.

items.title: Pilot arms reach the same choice

items.title: The same view history, different model choices
items.caption: Both Qwen models received the same ordered images of the dish sponge and return. Their final labels differed.
items.input_and_actions: DIAG02 original-model diagnostic. Images show public marked RGB at each decision, reconstructed losslessly and checked with original decision and ordered model-request image hashes. The scripted observation steps are controller actions; the final select is the model output (possibly reused under its recorded exact-input key).
